43:35.text: And adornments of gold. Yet all this
(i.e. the roofs, doors, stairs, elevators, thrones of their houses)
would have been nothing but an enjoyment of this world. And the Hereafter with your Lord is

43:36.text: And whosoever turns away blindly from the remembrance of the Most Gracious
(i.e. this Qur’ân and worship of Allâh)

43:37.text: , but they think that they are guided aright!

43:38.text: "Would that between me and you were the distance of the two easts

43:39.text: It will profit you not this Day
(O you who turn away from Allâh’s remembrance and His worship)

43:40.text: (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم)
make the deaf to hear, or can you guide the blind or him who is in manifest error?

43:41.text: And even if We take you
(O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم)
away, We shall indeed take vengeance on them.

43:42.text: We show you that wherewith We threaten them: then verily We have perfect command over them.

43:43.text: (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم)
fast to that which is revealed to you. Verily you are on the Straight Path.

to be worshipped besides the Most Gracious

43:46.text: And indeed We did send Mûsâ
(proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.)
(inviting them to Allâh’s religion of Islâm)
He said: "Verily, I am a Messenger of the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn
